inlines.v: DETAING, v.t. [L., to hold. See Tenant.] 1. To keep back or from; to withhold; to keep what belongs to another. Detain not the wages of the hireling.2. To keep or restrain from proceeding, either going or coming; to stay or stop. We were detained by the rain.Let us detain thee, till we have made ready a kid. Judges 13.3. To hold in custody.
